Height settlements at each round boundary (majority chain)

Every round boundary settles one height outcome from the votes already on chain. Bars: target (justify) votes and finality-piggyback votes counted by the spec state at that moment; dashed line: the 2/3 quorum. A red marker under the axis means the round's first slot had no block on the majority chain, so the last slot's votes could not be included before the settlement. Finality piggybacks accumulate across rounds (extended window); target votes do not.

target votes on chain finality votes on chain round-start block missing J = height justified · F = checkpoint finalized · – = no progress

30-Run Seeded Partition Sweep (16 Nodes, 64 Validators, 5 Seeds × 6 Settings)

Partition starts at slot 24 (round 3) for duration D ∈ {8, 16, 32} slots (1, 2, 4 rounds), then heals (GST). Each seed varies genesis RANDAO (committees & proposers), validator-to-node assignment, and per-message latency (200 ms + U[0, 100] ms). Dots show individual seeds; vertical bars show [min–max]; lines connect seed means.

50/50 split (8 vs 8 nodes — no 2/3 quorum during cut) 75/25 split (12 vs 4 nodes — 25% minority loses branch; 75% majority loses 0) Dashed: expected losing proposer share (~D/2 vs ~D/4)
1. Safe confirmation is not safe across a partition Losing side orphans ~D/2 blocks (50/50) or ~D/4 blocks (75/25 minority), including blocks reported as safe-confirmed (G0-clear), because is_g0_clear only vetoes conflicting branches visible in the node's local Store.
2. Zero conflicting stable roots or finalizations Across all 30 runs, stable roots are never conflicting (always identical or nested on one chain). After GST, heads reconverge within ≤ 1 slot in every single run.
3. Missing round-start blocks cost justification votes A boundary settlement counts only votes some block carried before it. When the round's first slot has no block, the last slot's voters drop out; with 75% online that often leaves < 2/3 target votes (checked against on-chain counts in 148/149 settlements). Finality piggybacks accumulate across rounds, so finalization is hit less often.
